oncall: Temp alert rules set: error_rate > 2.5x baseline OR P95 > baseline +100ms. Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/launch-freeze

Nikki: Rollback criteria: sustained error >= 3x baseline for 5m, P95 > baseline +100ms for 3 consecutive mins, or any customer-facing regression. Post `rollback` and tag @oncall if triggered.

Omar: Smoke passed. Auth & embed paths OK; tiny retry spike at t+2m resolved.

DocsBot: Release notes updated in Console. No DB migrations. Docs branch locked until freeze ends.
